pages.article_html:
Retrieve Our Lost Kin

Level 28 · Adventuring · Vault Of Heroes

Objectives

Slay Bloodhowler unicorn trappers and Bloodhowler bloodletters. Seek out Nathefel to the south of the Marsh of Peril, and Thanion to the east. After reestablishing contact and assisting them, return to Delsyr. - Reestablish Contact with Nathefel - Reestablish Contact with Thanion - Bloodhowler Unicorn Trappers & Bloodletters (0/45)

Description

Delsyr says, "As you can see, our situation is less than ideal." "When the Bloodhowlers came, our peaceful valley ran red with unicorn blood. We split into three groups to hide our numbers and divide the bloodhowler forces." "I galloped north, Nathefel south, and Thanion east. We lost contact with one another." "Once you've cleared a path through the Bloodhowler bloodletters and unicorn trappers, find Nathefel and Thanion. Tell them they are welcome to return to this valley."

What they say

On offering it

Delsyr
As you can see, our situation is less than ideal. When the Bloodhowlers came, our peaceful valley ran red with unicorn blood. We split into three groups to hide our numbers and divide the bloodhowler forces. I galloped north, Nathefel south, and Thanion east. We lost contact with one another. Once you've cleared a path through the Bloodhowler bloodletters and unicorn trappers, find Nathefel and Thanion. Tell them they are welcome to return to this valley.

Recorded by quest description.

Another account

A second source described this quest differently. Both are kept here; neither is a correction of the other.

findings.observation: Primary objectives request killing Bloodhowler unicorn trappers and bloodletters, contacting Nathefel south of Marsh of Peril and Thanion east, assisting both, then returning to Delsyr. Three tracker lines retain two contact objectives and Bloodhowler Unicorn Trappers & Bloodletters (0/45). The attributed fandom account instead prints Bloodhowler Unicorn Trappers and Bloodletter Slain (42). Preserve both full accounts without choosing the operative kill count.

The alternate account associates Nathefel contact with Reduced to Blood and Howls and Thanion contact with Unruined Flesh. The primary objective says contact and assist, without specifying a completion script. These are attributed chain associations, not proof of enforced prerequisite or quest-completion triggers.

Previous and Next both link Trapped Unicorns; Series prints Unicorn. The preceding reviewed Reduced To Blood And Howls page likewise links Retrieve Our Lost Kin as both Previous and Next. Retain this contradictory navigation without constructing a prerequisite cycle or deciding historical chain order.

Header prints Level 28, Adventuring and Vault Of Heroes. Details names Delsyr as starter and Vault Of Heroes as starting zone; location prints 64744, 64154, 32597 in Wardship of the Sleeping Moon (-23, 25). Objective return to Delsyr is explicit, although no Hand in to field appears. Preserve distinct zone and coordinate contexts without resolving canonical entity IDs or axes.

Offering dialogue describes the herd splitting into three groups, Delsyr north, Nathefel south and Thanion east. These narrative directions do not supply exact NPC spawn positions or prove historical pathing and escort mechanics.

The article provides no explicit repeatability or reward values. Experience, money denomination and reward items remain unknown. Source links archived MMODB; alternate account is attributed to fandom inside the cached archive. Neither original was fetched here and mirrors do not provide independent corroboration.
